notes: Phobos Agriculture loose items (Agriculture 0.25.0): Continuance planting stock, Groundwork nutrients and irrigation charges, produce and Hearth meals, recovery supplies and the recorded wastes. Masses the crop, recovery and workup models are written for (irrigation and nutrient charges, the recovery cartridge, makeup salts) are bound to their constants and refused if changed. Food and produce prices are authored balance beside the game's own rations.

PhobosVerdemorrowRecyclerWetRejects.notes: Wet rejects captured from the Ship's Water recycler: a terminal record, never processed again.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuancePotato.notes: Continuance seed potato, one per planting.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuanceWheat.notes: Continuance seed wheat, a 50 g packet: one planting.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuanceTomato.notes: Continuance tomato seed packet, 5 g: one planting.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuanceSoybean.notes: Continuance soybean seed packet, 30 g: one planting.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuanceFlax.notes: Continuance flax seed (linseed) packet, 10 g: one dense fibre sowing.

PhobosVerdemorrowContinuanceSugarBeet.notes: Continuance sugar beet seed packet, 20 g: one sowing.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkNutrients.notes: Groundwork 40 g nutrient charge for one rack cycle.

PhobosVerdemorrowRawPotatoes.notes: Raw potatoes, 0.4 kg; cook them in the Hearth-2.

PhobosVerdemorrowHearthPotatoes.notes: Hearth cooked potato portion, 0.4 kg; eaten directly.

PhobosVerdemorrowWheatGrain.notes: Wheat grain, 0.4 kg; dry, keeps indefinitely; bake it in the Hearth-2 with a water ration. Priced above raw potatoes: about four times the food energy, and it keeps.

PhobosVerdemorrowHearthFlatbread.notes: Hearth flatbread, 0.65 kg; eaten directly. Baking it with a bought water ration costs more than the loaf fetches: bread is supply, not trade.

PhobosVerdemorrowTomatoes.notes: Fresh tomatoes, 0.25 kg; eaten directly. Priced like lettuce.

PhobosVerdemorrowSoybeans.notes: Dry soybeans, 0.25 kg; they keep; cook them in the Hearth-2 with a water ration. Priced for their protein, below wheat grain by mass of food energy.

PhobosVerdemorrowFlaxStraw.notes: Retted flax straw, 0.25 kg: 88% organic matter, 2% minerals, 10% water (authored). The B2 scutches it into two clean scrap cloth (4.80 cr) and shives; not sold, so no bought bundle can be resold as cloth.

PhobosVerdemorrowSugarBeets.notes: Sugar beet root, 0.5 kg: 75% water, 17% sucrose, 5% pulp fibre, 3% other (authored within cited ranges). Not sold: a farm intermediate, so no bought beet becomes sugar or spirit for profit.

PhobosVerdemorrowBeetSugar.notes: White beet sugar, 70 g, from the B2. A small food, and fermenter feed. Not sold, for the same reason as the beets.

PhobosVerdemorrowHearthSoybeans.notes: Hearth soybean stew, 0.5 kg; eaten directly. Like bread, cooking it with a bought water ration costs more than it fetches.

PhobosVerdemorrowCropResidue.notes: Unrecorded crop residue from older crops: waste.

PhobosVerdemorrowCharacterizedProcessSol.notes: Recorded drainage awaiting treatment; its record carries the measured contents.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkRecoveryCartr.notes: Treatment cartridge, 50 g of medium, priced full; bound to the recovery model.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkIrrigation.notes: Groundwork 5 kg irrigation charge; bound to the rack model.

PhobosVerdemorrowRecordedCropResidue.notes: Recorded fresh crop residue, 0.5 kg, for the B2 workup.

PhobosVerdemorrowStrawBale.notes: Groundwork straw bale, 1 kg: 0.87 kg organic matter, 0.03 kg minerals and 0.10 kg water, pressed and dried at the B2 (Agriculture 0.44.0). Fuel and carbon feed for the Phobos Manufacturing V4. Not sold; priced low, as baled crop waste.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkMakeup.notes: Groundwork makeup salts, 40 g; bound to the workup model.

PhobosVerdemorrowGroundworkBulkNutrients.notes: Groundwork 500 g bulk nutrient charge, sold eight to a lot; bound to the bulk model.
